data.decision: Migrate Mission #0 with cp -a, diff -r, and git rm after directory rename failed on Windows
data.why: git mv and the Windows move command both returned access denied for a directory rename. cp -a produced an identical tree (diff -r exited 0), and git rm removed the source only after that check.
data.cost_if_wrong: A missed or altered file would show in diff -r; the validator and reconcile both pass on the migrated mission, and the ledger/evidence bytes are unchanged.

It also verified every relative markdown link resolves, every acceptance criterion B1-B7 is served by a task, and every ledger evidence path exists.

Pack mesh (B7): both present reports superpowers 7.0.1 and Impeccable skill 4.8.0 / engine 0.1.18; check-method --packs and --products --strict exit 0. With CAIRN_SUPERPOWERS_DIR, CAIRN_IMPECCABLE_DIR, and CAIRN_IMPECCABLE_BIN pointing at missing paths, both report absent, --products --strict still exits 0, and cairn next emits absent entries with executable fallbacks. No launcher ran and no engine was downloaded.

F1: protocol.md requires packs on every review_result, but live Mission #1 review_result events 27 and 38 predate the T7 human-approved amendment and carry no packs. The mission validator checks event names only, so the mission gate does not catch this. This final review carries packs. Follow-up for Mission #2: either enforce packs for events after the amendment timestamp or grandfather pre-amendment events explicitly by human-approved amendment.

F2: protocol.md CLI table names cairn answer and cairn export, which src/cli.ts does not implement. The protocol calls itself the contract and the CLI one implementation, so this is a contract/implementation gap, not a broken path. Follow-up: implement them or amend the table with human approval; do not silently delete the rows.

F3: plan.md still says T7 active and T8 todo while the ledger has task_done for T7 and T8. Plan status is an explicit hint (docs/workflow.md), and T8 does not declare plan.md, so this tick does not edit it; the ledger remains the truth.

F4: ledger event 42 records that the 22:19:51 mission_amended event was corrected in place from sha256:NEWHASH. That is an append-only violation, already disclosed by the note event; no history was rewritten further and no decision changed.
F5: docs/i18n.md marked README, workflow, inbox, and method/README rows as current at older commits even though T7 changed them. The T8 commit refreshes those status rows.

F6: README.md said Mission #0 builds Cairn with Cairn while protocol.md says Mission #0 builds it by hand and replaces each step. The T8 commit makes both say the same thing: a manual step is replaced by a command once the command exists and a gate proves it.
